Test Objective: Verify the documented POST route accepts the baseline JSON representation and returns the documented successful coupon calculation structure.
Preconditions: SAVE10 exists with the documented percent value and minimum order, is active and unexpired; user 1 has zero prior uses; a valid JWT for the test user is available.
Request Input: POST /api/apply-coupon with Authorization: Bearer <valid JWT> and JSON body {"code":"SAVE10","total_amount":500000,"user_id":1}.
Expected Result: The response is JSON containing both discount_amount and final_amount; discount_amount is 50000 and final_amount is 450000. No HTTP status code is asserted.
Specification Basis: CR-001, CR-002, CR-003, CR-004, CR-005, CR-006, CR-007, CR-008, CR-010, CR-011; API specification §5.1 lines 154-162; System requirements FR-09 lines 112-132; SEC-02 line 279.
Assumptions / Notes: The baseline setup assumes the valid JWT identifies the test user represented by user_id 1; the sources do not define this as a general identity-binding rule. The API specification does not document a success status or concrete response MIME string.
